title: HF1438 (2019-2020 Regular): Weapons at polling place prohibition established, and criminal penalties provided.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/91/2019/0/HF/1438/versions/0/)

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 203B.03, new subd. 1a): Section 204C.06, subdivision 9, applies to the possession of certain weapons in polling places where absentee ballots are cast.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 204C.06, new subd. 9): (a) Whoever possesses, stores, or keeps a firearm in a location the person knows is a polling place is guilty of a felony and may be sentenced to imprisonment for not more than five years or to payment of a fine of not more than $10,000, or both. (b) Whoever uses or brandishes a replica firearm or a BB gun in a location the person knows is a polling place is guilty of a gross misdemeanor. (c) Whoever possesses, stores, or keeps a replica firearm or a BB gun in a location the person knows is a polling place is guilty of a misdemeanor. (d) Notwithstanding paragraph (a), (b), or (c), it is a misdemeanor for a person authorized to carry a firearm under the provisions of a permit or otherwise to carry a firearm on or about the person's clothes or person in a location the person knows is a polling place. Notwithstanding section 609.531, a firearm carried in violation of this paragraph is not subject to forfeiture.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 204C.06, new subd. 9): (f) This subdivision does not apply to: (1) active licensed peace officers; and (2) military personnel or students participating in military training who are on-duty and performing official duties.
